FINAL ANSWER BLOCK:
METRIC: hyp_prefixtree_isometry
TITLE: Rank fidelity of the SID prefix tree, realised as a geodesic tree of hyperbolic Frechet barycentres in the frozen reference Poincare ball, to the reference distances over all training pairs.
FORMULA: curvature c=1. Ball ops: d(u,v)=(2/sqrt c) artanh(sqrt c ||(-u)(+)v||); exp_0(w)=tanh(sqrt c ||w||) w/(sqrt c ||w||). FRE(S)=Karcher mean: start exp_0(mean log_0 x), then 60x b<-exp_b(0.5 mean log_b x), log_b(y)=log_0((-b)(+)y)/(1-c||b||^2). For level l, p_l(i)=FRE of source reps of the level-l cell of item i, reused for all members. D(i,j)=sum_{l=1..L} d(p_l(i),p_l(j)). R(i,j)=d(x_i,x_j). score=Spearman{D,R} over P = 200000 distinct pairs i<j of training-split items drawn by numpy default_rng(0). Range [-1,1], higher better.
INPUTS: exported SID table (integer code per item per level); frozen Issue126 reference source representation per item plus the training-split item list. Nothing else, no val/test interaction, no recall.
GEOMETRY: fixed negative curvature c=1. Curvature enters in (a) each cell summarised by a hyperbolic Frechet barycentre via log/exp maps and Poincare distances, (b) the SID distance is a sum of Poincare distances between those barycentres, realising the prefix trie as a geodesic tree in the ball. At c->0 it degenerates to Euclidean means plus Euclidean distance, exactly the degenerate linear-projection case the curvature exists to avoid.
WHY IT SHOULD TRACK RECALL: recall@10 is a rank question over all pairs. Q_H scores one canonical prefix contrast; HBAA scores one anchor against a mean of ten negatives. This scores the whole hierarchy against the whole item cloud over ~2e5 pairs, invariant to which item is the query, and asks whether the SID table is a low-distortion hyperbolic summary of the reference ball. Deep levels do not collapse the score because a level-l cell contributes the geodesic spread of its own barycentre, which shrinks to zero as a cell becomes one item; a semantically coherent deep level still adds resolution.
COMPUTE: barycentres once, ~24587*60*2 ~3e6 exp/log evaluations, then 2e5 pairs x L<=4 Poincare distances ~1e6 ops; under 10 s single core on 24587 items and 256 codes.
RISKS: saturation if reference pair distances are dominated by a large-scale gradient; unbalanced cell sizes making levels redundant; fixed pair sample; near-rank-1 reference reps destroying the coherence signal.
FAILURE MODE: worst on a table with semantically scrambled level-1 codes but a perfectly balanced trie (hash assignment): barycentres cluster near the origin, D becomes nearly constant, Spearman -> 0. Also 0 on the all-distinct-level-1-code table (constant D) and on the one-code table (D identically 0, undefined, scored 0).
END METRIC
